HP3The home page, for individuals and coaches
COACH MILAN, 1 NOVEMBER 10:48 TO 11:23
The page targets coaches and individuals. Beta testers get free access, spots are limited, and testing asks for commitment. Real users will pay; they form a waiting list, separate from the beta.
THE TOP
The promise and the crave calculator stay. The top bar on one line: Chef Mealan, Coaches, Sign in (Milan 11:57: For coaches broke into two lines). Coaches scrolls to the coach section. Recipes leaves the bar on a phone; the recipes section keeps All recipes. The box under the calculator: Join the beta, free; the spots left, from the number you set under Coach; the commitment: use it most days for four weeks, and tell us what breaks; a link to the waiting list.
FOR THE INDIVIDUAL
The day in order. Start from anything: two clips, not four. One plate. Plan and shop. New: Cook it, hands free. New: Your day as it really goes (situations, calendar, Travel mode). New: Explorer, know why, not only what.
FOR THE COACH
A section of its own, at Coaches: one account, two views; suggest, the client accepts; answer or react on shared meals; Waiting for you; the client decides what you see. Its own button: Get a coach code.
TRUST
Two lines more: papers read again before each release; an account nobody opens for 12 months is deleted.
TWO FORMS
Join the beta, free: as today, with the spots and the commitment. The waiting list: email, Which fits you?, a tick to be written to when it opens. When the spots reach 0, the waiting list becomes the main button. The book page's round-is-full line points to it.
THE PHOTOS
Milan 12:25 to 12:31: proper photos, to stay. The barcode clip: a Fjell Skyr tub (a picture made with AI, the brand invented) in a hand, with the real code drawn into its empty label, so the app's scanner reads it. The meal clip: Milan's real dinner of 31 October, salmon, potatoes and broccoli, the whole plate in the camera's view. Each of the two shows the camera with the tub or the plate as its picture.
THE SPOTS NUMBER
One number, set under Clients (Beta spots left, since BP70 on 21 October, 0.2.87), shown in two places: the book page, as today, and now the home page's beta box. Its label under Clients says shown on the home page and the book page. Milan 12:17: keep that design and solution.
THE APP'S PICTURES
Coach Milan 11:40: Explorer shows in every new design, and the app's pictures sit in the middle. Every clip is recorded again on today's app, so the bar has all five tabs; a new rule, HC11, stops the recording when Explorer is missing. Each clip's picture is now its last screen, what the clip is about (HC12): the shopping list showed Plan before. The new sections show stills of today's app in the same phone frame as the clips, centred, with made-up names. They become clips after this board is approved.
NOT IN THIS BOARD
Prices. The launch email and its double opt-in (an EU mail tool, at launch). The rulebook (DT197).
